agent_evaluations.detailed_feedback: This OSCE script collection requires substantial revision before deployment. While the structure, Australian terminology, and citation quality are appropriate, the core content lacks specific radiological interpretations. All 50 cases use identical generic placeholder text ('The investigations show findings consistent with [condition]') rather than demonstrating systematic image interpretation. For radiology OSCE stations, candidates must be assessed on their ability to use systematic approaches (ABCDE for CXR, 7-step for ECG, ABC for CT), identify specific findings, and correlate with clinical context. The current content does not achieve this educational objective. Priority actions: (1) Replace all generic interpretation text with specific, systematic findings for each case; (2) Verify actual image content matches described findings OR clearly label as simulated teaching cases; (3) Customize vital signs to match each condition's clinical presentation; (4) Add image quality assessment statements; (5) Include critical results communication where appropriate. Once revised, this collection could serve as an excellent AMC Clinical Examination respiratory radiology teaching resource.

recommended_actions.action: Engage radiology expert to write specific systematic interpretations for all 50 cases following RANZCR reporting standards
Verify all referenced image files exist and contain authentic findings matching the described conditions, OR relabel as simulated cases
Customize vital signs and clinical presentations to match each specific respiratory condition (not identical across all 50 cases)
Add model answers demonstrating full systematic interpretation approach for each image type (ABCDE/7-step/ABC)
Pilot test 5-10 revised cases with AMC candidates or junior doctors to validate educational effectiveness
